title: Fix: unsubscribed readers still get the newsletter
hints: The bug only shows up for some addresses. Compare one that gets removed properly with `Ana@Example.com`. What's different about it?
Each sign-up is turned into a `key` with `.strip().lower()`, but the addresses in `unsubscribed` only get `.strip()`. A lowercase key is never `in` a set that still holds capital letters.
Normalise both sides the same way: `{email.strip().lower() for email in unsubscribes}`.
